tools.title: HubSpot
tools.summary: CRM, marketing, sales and service hub.

servers.name: Remote HubSpot MCP server
servers.capabilities: Read and write CRM records, activities, content, campaigns, marketing email drafts, pipelines and properties, acting with the user's HubSpot permissions.

tools.notes: OAuth 2.1 with PKCE through an MCP connector created in the HubSpot account; GA status comes from HubSpot's changelog. A separate Developer MCP server exists for building on HubSpot (not listed).

tools.title: Pipedrive

servers.name: Pipedrive MCP
servers.capabilities: Find deals, contacts, organizations and leads; create or update records, add notes, create activities and move deals between stages, within the user's permissions.

tools.notes: Available on all Pipedrive plans with plan-based token limits; the user needs permission to install apps in Pipedrive.

tools.title: Salesforce
tools.summary: CRM platform for sales, service and marketing.

servers.name: Salesforce Hosted MCP Server (platform/sobject-all)
servers.capabilities: Read, create, update and delete standard and custom object records; platform/sobject-reads is the read-only variant.

access.consent: An administrator enables the selected MCP server and configures an External Client App. Each user authorizes the app
scopes: Salesforce object, field and record permissions still apply

tools.notes: Enterprise Edition or above (or Developer Edition); an admin enables each server in Setup > API Catalog > MCP Servers and creates an External Client App (scopes mcp_api, refresh_token). Sandbox URL: https://api.salesforce.com/platform/mcp/v1/sandbox/{servername}; the beta v1-beta.2 URLs no longer work. The local @salesforce/mcp DX server reached end of life on 2 Nov 2026.
